DIAGNOSIS READY: Syringomyelia.

The MRI finding of a syrinx extending from the cervical to the upper thoracic region explains your chronic burning pain, bilateral hand weakness, and paresthesias. This fluid-filled cavity damages the spinal cord tracts, which is distinct from the neuropathy typically caused by your diabetes. Do you have any recent history of headaches, particularly when bending forward, or any changes in sensation around your neck?
